records.contents_note: 84 explicit fetches of blobs by id (git fetch origin --filter=blob:none --stdin) and 4 lazy fetches of missing blobs from the promisor remote by commands that read them: 1 by a git cat-file probe, the stage's first operation (90 blobs, 1,602,446 bytes), and 3 by git archive of a base. One of the 3 archived a monorepo package's base in repository 4127088 as the commit with the package's directory as a pathspec, before D59's compiler fix. On a blob-less partial clone that form fetches every missing blob of the whole commit: here 75,508,199 bytes (13.1% of this stage and 98.7% of what it added to that clone), nearly all outside the package, whose 75 blobs had been fetched by id just before (257,961 bytes). Since the fix, a monorepo package's base is archived as its subtree (D59), and the later archives in that repository fetched nothing. The other 2 archived bases that are not monorepo packages and fetched 1,214 and 1,253 bytes, consistent with the blobs of symbolic links: natural_pr.materialize_base fetches only regular files' blobs by id before it archives. Every operation exited 0. The 14 repositories are those of the first sample's 25 families; the 6 accepted families come from 5 of them. Every operation but the first ran under a watchdog that polls the clone's size every second against the caps of 300,000,000 bytes per repository and 5,000,000,000 in all (du -sb, both stages counted); the first, the cat-file probe, ran outside it, as its log line says. One repository went over the per-repository cap (status over_cap). D59's 574.6 MB matches the 31 operations from 08:59Z, when its run began (574,566,108 bytes); the 57 operations before it, from 2026-11-21T07:43:57Z to 2026-11-21T08:27:41Z (2 probes, then licence, declaration, path-requirement and changed-code blobs, without base trees), add 2,036,423 bytes. The base snapshots made from these blobs are in data/natural/snapshots/, and the S10 work trees in data/natural/s10_work/, both git-ignored. S10 of the extension's families (from NP-26) is not included. This record carries no task id and no time per repository: its rows are listed by repository id in ascending order (D63). It does not link a repository to a task by itself; data/manifests/natural_tasks_index.json does, through each task's repo_id, and aidev-v5-s9-repo-fetches gives each repository's URL
